description_detailed: To celebrate the 25th anniversary of the cinema release of the first chapter of Peter Jackson's trilogy, Monnaie de Paris will unveil a collection of precious coins dedicated to the legendary Lord of the Rings series in 2026. From the Shire to Mordor, the perilous journey of the Fellowship of the Ring is now engraved in metal, celebrating a mythical saga that has become a true pillar of the fantasy genre.Above the walls of the Black Door, the sky itself becomes a battlefield. As the Nazgûl sweep down upon the city, embodying Sauron's fear and domination, darkness seems for a moment to overcome all hope.At this critical moment, the appearance of the Great Eagles tips the balance. Surging from the heights, they bring with them a breath of deliverance. Their intervention breaks the hold of darkness and gives men the strength to continue the fight.
